##### Project general facts

Riviera 13 by Azizi Developments is a residential building within a waterfront community that combines a French Mediterranean design perspective with modern architecture. Soft facade tones, balconies and generous glazing give the building a light, elegant character, while the surrounding boulevard, lagoon and greenery create a relaxed resort setting. The building rises from a ground floor to seven residential floors, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Residents enjoy a swimming pool surrounded by relaxation areas, a yoga zone and a tranquil Zen garden for everyday wellness. A lounge, barbecue seating areas and an outdoor children's play area create welcoming places for families and friends, while the wider community adds landscaped parks, walking paths, a lagoon beach, boutiques, cafes and restaurants, so that leisure, dining and shopping are always within easy reach of home.

Apartments are finished with high-quality materials throughout, combining practical layouts with contemporary design and plenty of natural light. Premium appliances and bathroom fittings support comfortable everyday living, while balconies extend the living space outdoors. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and making each apartment easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Azizi Riviera is a large waterfront community within Meydan One in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, inspired by the French Riviera and built around a crystal lagoon. A long boulevard lined with cafes, boutiques, supermarkets and restaurants, landscaped parks, walking paths and a lagoon beach create a lively yet relaxed setting, with everyday needs within walking distance of every building.

Al Khail Road and Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. The Meydan Hotel and Meydan Racecourse are close by, Downtown Dubai, The Dubai Mall and Business Bay are a short drive away, and Dubai Design District, Dubai Festival City, the Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance for work, leisure and travel.

Azizi Riviera is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular mid-market waterfront addresses close to Downtown Dubai. Ready homes with lagoon views, integrated retail and an established community attract professionals and families, supporting steady rental demand. Competitive prices and a central location underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors.
